goalbuddy_receipt_v1.summary: Authenticated v1.56.3 types expose six Flow fields, three screens, composable conditions, modal/layout/appearance controls, five built-in/immediate transition choices plus custom motion, issue/evidence mapping, and open/result lifecycle. Current docs cover the default widget and Variants but omit registerFlow and authoritative Flow references. Homepage/lab examples exercise useful subsets; the simulator separately advertises unreleased multiSelect. Existing focused tests pass, while CI/browser contracts do not prove exhaustive type/docs parity, every motion/style option, or reduced-motion accessibility. Recommended IA: preserve Getting Started; add Custom Flows and Flow Reference, then extend JavaScript API and Styling. Prefer new manifest/example/test files and clean docs files; coordinate carefully around already-dirty homepage, CI, integration, and e2e files.

No Flow navigation/page; API documents registerVariant but not registerFlow; styling documents script attributes/Shadow DOM but not Flow appearance/presentation.

Current exact-runtime examples cover all six fields and three screens plus selected conditions, layouts, appearance, issue/evidence mappings, but all homepage demos force the same 500ms horizontal transition.
Simulator model advertises multiSelect, while exact-runtime lab configs use released fields; these concepts are currently mixed under one lab route.
Desktop/mobile and local no-external-mutation checks exist, but there is no exhaustive capability-manifest parity gate or every-transition/style/reduced-motion docs journey.
Dirty baseline includes CI, homepage implementation/tests/docs, deleted old runtime routes/assets, and untracked v1.56.3 runtime/routes/goals; public docs MDX and docs navigation are currently clean.
